page.overview:
Who is Shigetaka Yangu?

Shigetaka bears a similar appearance to Shigechi from Diamond is Unbreakable but with hair and a more normal-looking face.

Shigetaka had only been mentioned in Chapter 6. One day his Stand brought a severed hand in its mouth, they searched for the man responsible with the nail polish brand on the hand. They learn it was a man by the name of Yoshikage Kira, they had almost caught him before he changed his identity using Tsuji Aya's Stand, Face/Off and had killed her and Shigechi as a warning.

Shigetaka wields the Stand Stray Dog, which allows him to control all sorts of stray dogs in the town of Morioh.
